crew_paddle_readability.high_side_paddles_previous_state: Explicitly hidden for all five crew avatars.
crew_paddle_readability.v627_result: Technically accepted: equipment no longer disappears and both hands remain on the shaft; the inherited primitive blade is weak.
crew_paddle_readability.v629_result: Rejected: a full-scale 53 cm modeled blade and long outside extension dominate the close camera.
crew_paddle_readability.v631_result: Rejected as final evidence: compact geometry fixes scale, but arbitrary blade roll makes most blades edge-on.
crew_paddle_readability.v632_result: Retained technical upgrade: compact blade, real shaft diameter, T-grip, and controlled feather angle improve rafting-action readability without obscuring the frame.

decision: Retain v632 as a bounded crew-equipment readability improvement. It removes the impossible all-paddle disappearance, keeps both hands on each visible shaft, and provides a recognizable modeled whitewater-paddle silhouette without changing D4, collision, live-water sampling, raft state, or rescue behavior. The frame remains rejected for photoreal and release-media acceptance because the CC0 bodies, faces, hands, hair/PPE integration, water, boulder, raft, aerosol, shoreline, terrain, and lighting remain visibly synthetic or unfinished.
